descriptionByLocale.it:
Ubicazione: Vers-chez-les-Blanc, Svizzera
Modello di lavoro: basato su ufficio
Tipo di contratto / durata: Permanente

Formare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione

In qualità di Specialista Associato - Agricoltura Rigenerativa (Caffé & Cocoa) presso Nestlé Research, la vostra missione è di contribuire alla progettazione e consegna di caffè e cacao ricerca agricola rigenerativa allineata con gli impegni di Corporate Creating Shared Value e la strategia di ricerca Nestlé Institute of Agricultural Sciences. Potrai fare la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con i sistemi agricoli team, project leader, ricercatori, agronomisti, team operativi, agricoltori, istituti di ricerca, università e partner esterni. Questa è la vostra occasione per trasformare le idee in soluzioni sostenibili e innovative per persone, animali domestici e il pianeta.

Come farete un impatto come Specialista Associato - Agricoltura Rigenerativa (Caffé & Cocoa)

• Attuazione della ricerca agricola rigenerativa che promuova la creazione di valore condiviso nei sistemi di produzione di caffè e cacao.

• Coordinate le prove sul campo all'avanguardia, la raccolta dei dati e l'analisi con team interni e partner esterni.

• Utilizzare rigore scientifico per trasformare la raccolta di dati di alta qualità in output di ricerca robusti.

• Convertire i risultati della ricerca in indicazioni pratiche e raccomandazioni per la distribuzione on-farm.

• Fornire nuovi approfondimenti di ricerca entro termini concordati, pietre miliari, standard e budget.

• Costruire competenze agricole rigenerative per rafforzare le prestazioni del team e la collaborazione scientifica.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare un PhD in agronomia, agricoltura, scienza vegetale o una disciplina correlata con esperienza pratica nella ricerca agricola, prove sul campo o agronomia applicata, idealmente con esposizione al caffè o al cacao.

• Applicare l'agricoltura rigenerativa, la gestione delle colture e la conoscenza della salute del suolo per fornire risultati di ricerca robusti.

• Utilizzando strumenti di analisi dei dati, documentazione e reportistica per creare uscite tecniche chiare, tracciabili e attuabili.

• Collaborare tra pubblico scientifico, tecnico e operativo con problem solving pratico, attenzione ai dettagli e comunicazione tempestiva.

• Comunicare fluentemente in inglese.

• Portare la collaborazione, il pensiero fresco, domande audaci, il rispetto e una mentalità positiva, orientata al benessere, per creare valore condiviso.

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati a un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo lieti di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione include tipicamente un'intervista con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. A seconda del ruolo, può essere inclusa una valutazione video. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che un forte elenco di candidati pertinenti è identificato, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate con riservatezza.

Rimanere vigili: Nestlé contatterà i candidati solo tramite gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non chiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili in qualsiasi fase del processo di assunzione.

Pronto a #BreakthroughTogether?

Applicare ora e plasmare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Location: Vers-chez-les-Blanc, Switzerland
Work model: Office-based
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation

As an Associate Specialist - Regenerative Agriculture (Coffee & Cocoa) at Nestlé Research, your mission is to contribute to the design and delivery of coffee and cocoa regenerative agriculture research aligned with corporate Creating Shared Value commitments and the business-endorsed Nestlé Institute of Agricultural Sciences research strategy. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with agricultural systems teams, project leaders, researchers, agronomists, operations teams, farmers, research institutes, universities and external partners. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as an Associate Specialist - Regenerative Agriculture (Coffee & Cocoa)

• Implementing regenerative agriculture research that advance the creation of shared value in coffee and cocoa production systems.

• Coordinate state-of-the-art field trials, data collection, and analysis with internal teams and external partners.

• Use scientific rigour to turn high-quality data collection into robust research outputs.

• Convert research findings into practical guidance and recommendations for on-farm deployment.

• Deliver novel research insights within agreed timelines, milestones, standards, and budgets.

• Build regenerative agriculture expertise to strengthen team performance and scientific collaboration.

What will make you successful

• Bringing a PhD in agronomy, agriculture, plant science or a related discipline along with practical experience in agricultural research, field trials or applied agronomy, ideally with exposure to coffee or cocoa.

• Applying regenerative agriculture, crop management and soil health knowledge to deliver robust research outcomes.

• Using data analysis, documentation and reporting tools to create clear, traceable and actionable technical outputs.

• Collaborating across scientific, technical and operational audiences with practical problem solving, attention to detail and timely communication.

• Communicating fluently in English.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset, to create shared value.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. Depending on the role, a video assessment may be included. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to #BreakthroughTogether?

Apply now and shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

Gestaltung der Zukunft durch wissenschaftliche Durchbrüche und Innovationen

Als Associate Specialist - Regenerative Agriculture (Coffee & Cocoa) bei Nestlé Research ist es Ihre Mission, zur Gestaltung und Lieferung von Forschungen zur regenerativen Landwirtschaft von Kaffee und Kakao beizutragen, die auf die Verpflichtung des Unternehmens zur Schaffung eines gemeinsamen Wertes und die von Unternehmen unterstützte Forschungsstrategie des Nestlé Institute of Agricultural Sciences ausgerichtet sind. Sie werden einen Unterschied machen, indem Sie eng mit landwirtschaftlichen Systemteams, Projektleitern, Forschern, Agronomen, Betriebsteams, Landwirten, Forschungsinstituten, Universitäten und externen Partnern zusammenarbeiten. Dies ist Ihre Chance, Ideen in nachhaltige und innovative Lösungen für Menschen, Haustiere und den Planeten zu verwandeln.

Wie Sie als Associate Specialist etwas bewirken - Regenerative Landwirtschaft (Kaffee & Kakao)

• Umsetzung regenerativer Landwirtschaftsforschung, die die Schaffung gemeinsamer Werte in Kaffee- und Kakaoproduktionssystemen vorantreibt.

• Koordinieren Sie modernste Feldversuche, Datenerfassung und -analyse mit internen Teams und externen Partnern.

• Nutzen Sie wissenschaftliche Strenge, um hochwertige Datensammlung in robuste Forschungsergebnisse umzuwandeln.

• Umsetzung von Forschungsergebnissen in praktische Leitlinien und Empfehlungen für den Einsatz im landwirtschaftlichen Betrieb.

• Liefern Sie neue Forschungsergebnisse innerhalb der vereinbarten Zeitpläne, Meilensteine, Standards und Budgets.

• Aufbau einer regenerativen Landwirtschaftsexpertise zur Stärkung der Teamleistung und wissenschaftlichen Zusammenarbeit.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Einen PhD in Agronomie, Landwirtschaft, Pflanzenwissenschaften oder einer verwandten Disziplin zusammen mit praktischen Erfahrungen in der Agrarforschung, Feldversuchen oder angewandten Agronomie, idealerweise mit Kaffee oder Kakao.

• Anwendung von Wissen über regenerative Landwirtschaft, Erntemanagement und Bodengesundheit, um robuste Forschungsergebnisse zu liefern.

• Verwendung von Datenanalyse-, Dokumentations- und Berichtstools zur Erstellung klarer, nachvollziehbarer und umsetzbarer technischer Ergebnisse.

• Zusammenarbeit zwischen wissenschaftlichen, technischen und operativen Zielgruppen mit praktischer Problemlösung, Liebe zum Detail und zeitnaher Kommunikation.

• fließend auf Englisch kommunizieren.

• Zusammenarbeit, frisches Denken, mutige Fragen, Respekt und eine positive, auf Wohlbefinden ausgerichtete Denkweise, um gemeinsame Werte zu schaffen.

Was Sie von unserem Einstellungsprozess erwarten können

Wir verpflichten uns zu einer inklusiven und respektvollen einstellungserfahrung und freuen uns, bei bedarf angemessene unterkünfte zu bieten. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden von einer starken Sicherheitskultur mit modernen Installationen und Verfahren unterstützt, um eine sichere Umgebung für alle zu gewährleisten.

Der Einstellungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Interview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Interview mit dem Einstellungsteam und eine abschließende Diskussion und ein Angebot. Abhängig von der Rolle kann eine Videobewertung enthalten sein. Wir überprüfen Bewerbungen, sobald sie eingegangen sind, und schließen die Rolle, sobald eine starke Liste relevanter Kandidaten identifiziert wurde, daher empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich frühzeitig zu bewerben. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Bleiben Sie wachsam: Nestlé wird Kandidaten nur über offizielle Firmen-E-Mail-Adressen kontaktieren und wird zu keinem Zeitpunkt des Einstellungsprozesses Zahlungen oder sensible persönliche Informationen verlangen.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Lieu: Vers-chez-les-Blanc, Suisse
Modèle de travail : Bureau
Type / durée du contrat : Permanent

Façonner l'avenir par des percées scientifiques et l'innovation

En tant que spécialiste associé de l'agriculture régénératrice (Cafee & Cocoa) chez Nestlé Research, votre mission est de contribuer à la conception et à la livraison de la recherche agricole régénérative sur le café et le cacao, conformément aux engagements de création de valeur partagée de l'entreprise et à la stratégie de recherche de l'Institut des sciences agricoles de Nestlé. Vous ferez la différence en collaborant étroitement avec les équipes de systèmes agricoles, les chefs de projet, les chercheurs, les agronomes, les équipes opérationnelles, les agriculteurs, les instituts de recherche, les universités et les partenaires extérieurs. C'est l'occasion de transformer les idées en solutions durables et innovantes pour les gens, les animaux de compagnie et la planète.

Comment vous ferez un impact en tant que spécialiste associé - Agriculture régénératrice (Cafee & Cocoa)

• Mettre en oeuvre une recherche agricole régénératrice qui favorise la création de valeur partagée dans les systèmes de production de café et de cacao.

• Coordonner les essais de pointe sur le terrain, la collecte de données et l'analyse avec les équipes internes et les partenaires externes.

• Utilisez la rigueur scientifique pour transformer la collecte de données de haute qualité en résultats de recherche robustes.

• Convertir les résultats de la recherche en conseils pratiques et en recommandations pour le déploiement à la ferme.

• Fournir de nouvelles perspectives de recherche dans les délais, les étapes, les normes et les budgets convenus.

• Bâtir une expertise en agriculture régénératrice pour renforcer la performance de l'équipe et la collaboration scientifique.

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Apporter un doctorat en agronomie, en agriculture, en sciences végétales ou dans une discipline connexe, ainsi qu'une expérience pratique en recherche agricole, en essais sur le terrain ou en agronomie appliquée, idéalement avec exposition au café ou au cacao.

• Appliquer l'agriculture régénératrice, la gestion des cultures et les connaissances en santé des sols pour produire des résultats de recherche solides.

• Utiliser des outils d'analyse des données, de documentation et de rapport pour créer des extrants techniques clairs, traçables et exploitables.

• Collaborer à l'échelle du public scientifique, technique et opérationnel avec la résolution de problèmes pratiques, l'attention aux détails et la communication opportune.

• Communiquer couramment en anglais.

• Apporter la collaboration, la pensée fraîche, les questions audacieuses, le respect et un état d'esprit positif et axé sur le bien-être, pour créer une valeur partagée.

À quoi s'attendre de notre processus d'embauche

Nous nous engageons à offrir une expérience d'embauche inclusive et respectueuse et sommes heureux de fournir des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables au besoin. Nos lieux de travail sont entièrement accessibles et soutenus par une solide culture de sécurité, avec des installations et des procédures modernes pour assurer un environnement sûr pour tous.

Le processus d'embauche comprend généralement une entrevue avec Talent Acquisition, une entrevue avec l'équipe d'embauche et une discussion et une offre finales. Selon le rôle, une évaluation vidéo peut être incluse. Nous examinons les candidatures reçues et clôturons le rôle une fois qu'une liste solide de candidats pertinents a été établie. Nous vous encourageons donc à présenter votre candidature tôt. Toutes les informations sont traitées de façon confidentielle.

Restez vigilant : Nestlé communiquera uniquement avec les candidats par l'intermédiaire des adresses électroniques officielles de l'entreprise et ne demandera jamais de paiements ou de renseignements personnels sensibles à n'importe quelle étape du processus d'embauche.

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Junior Research Assistant in Packaging Safety at Nestlé Research, your mission is to develop, validate and apply analytical methods for novel coated paper packaging materials. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with teammates, research colleagues, operations teams, quality managers and external partners. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Junior Research Assistant in Packaging Safety

• Contribute to the development of robust analytical methods that help assess the safety and performance of innovative packaging materials.

• Perform packaging characterization analyses that support reliable research outcomes and project decisions.

• Consolidating and interpreting data and writing clear analytical documentation that enables quality, research and project teams to act with confidence.

• Participate in transferring analytical methods to operations and supporting end users throughout the method lifecycle.

• Contributing to quality, safety and knowledge-sharing practices that help teams work consistently across sites.

• Engage with internal and external partners to stay at the forefront of packaging safety science and analytical technologies.

What will make you successful

• Master’s degree in chemistry, analytical chemistry or a related scientific discipline, combined with a strong interest in analytical sciences, packaging safety and sustainable packaging technologies.

• Applying knowledge of gas chromatography-mass spectrometry, liquid chromatography-high resolution mass spectrometry or material characterization.

• Using hands-on laboratory experience from academic projects, internships or research activities to deliver reliable experimental work.

• Collaborating with curiosity, attention to detail and strong data analysis, problem-solving and scientific reporting skills.

• Working proficiency in English and French.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset.

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further

As the Head of Global Business Services Finance at Nestlé, your mission is to act as a key finance partner to the Head of GBS and the GBS Management Team. You will shape the financial roadmap, challenge business decisions, and ensure disciplined planning, performance management, cost transparency and value realization across the global GBS network. Working closely with Center Heads, End-to-End solution leads, Global Process Owners, Markets, IT & Digital, and external partners, you will provide forward-looking insights, enable fact-based decisions, and strengthen accountability for financial outcomes. You will lead an international finance team in different locations and help GBS deliver sustainable efficiency, effectiveness, and business value.

How you’ll make an impact as a Head of GBS Finance

• Bring deep expertise in the operational financial management of Global Business Services, using cost, efficiency, quality and service-performance insights to improve both efficiency and effectiveness.

• While leveraging AI tools, develop and maintain unit-cost, productivity and service-performance measures that connect financial outcomes with operational volumes, quality and service levels. Use internal and external benchmarks to identify improvement opportunities.

• Planning, coordinating and maintaining cost control of our Business Centers operations, measuring performance against plan and proposing necessary action plans to achieve targets in a context of important transition plan.

• Ensure challenging stretched targets are set for each Shared Service Center, end-to-end solution lead and Management Services unit, and tracking performance in a timely manner.

• Establish and govern a consistent framework to validate, track and report productivity, transformation benefits and value delivery, including agreed baselines, ownership, timing and reconciliation to reported financial results.

• Ensure a robust, documented and transparent billing and reconciliation process across the GBS network, including accurate and timely charges to internal customers, clear allocation drivers, dispute resolution and compliance with applicable transfer-pricing and accounting requirements.

• Own and continuously improve a transparent, driver-based costing and charging model for GBS services. Define financial evaluation and performance-tracking methodologies, assess business cases and contract changes, and ensure continuity plans reflect current financial exposures and operational requirements.

• Lead financial and commercial governance of external service providers, including contract economics, rate cards, indexation, volume commitments, service credits, change requests, invoice validation and value-for-money assessments.

• Lead, develop and inspire your team in an international environment while working collaboratively and cross functionally with IT & Digital, Global Process Owners and Markets.

What will make you successful

• Demonstrating senior finance leadership experience in GBS operational financial models and in complex global organizations, supported by relevant finance, accounting or business qualification.

• Applying financial analysis and co-piloting experience to various senior stakeholders through a strong command of management accounting, planning and forecasting, service costing, investment appraisal, financial controls and commercial contract management.

• Developing and improving financial systems and major business processes, with exposure to audit, project financial evaluation and contract reviews.

• Strong focus on compliance, rock solid reporting and internal controls.

• Managing and developing people, including virtual teams, with good organizational and planning skills.

• Communicating fluently in English, with superior written and verbal communication skills to effectively address and influence all levels, leadership team and internal customers.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

At Nestlé, we care about our people

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities

• Performance based bonus

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Research Alliances & Science Insourcing Lead at Nestlé Research, your mission is to ensure Nestlé Research has access to the best science globally. Working closely with research leaders, science and technology teams, legal and contract partners, universities, research institutes, startups, scientific publishers, associations, and external experts, you will help transform ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as Research Alliances & Science Insourcing Lead

• Leading the research alliances and science insourcing strategy to build high-value partnerships with academia, startups, publishers, scientific and innovation ecosystems.

• Driving strategic collaborations that accelerate discovery, strengthen innovation impact, and support Nestlé Research priorities.

• Creating seamless access to internal and external scientific knowledge by connecting researchers to experts, scientific literature, publishers, information sources, and research services that expand Nestlé Research capabilities.

• Transforming scientific intelligence into a strategic capability by identifying, connecting, and translating emerging scientific trends, publications, and external expertise into actionable insights for research and innovation.

• Strengthening Nestlé Research’s scientific reputation by building trusted relationships with universities, talent pools, and external thought leaders.

• Developing an engaged, inclusive, and future-ready team that builds capabilities, fosters collaboration, and delivers shared priorities.

What will make you successful

• Bringing a PhD or equivalent scientific background, combined with the credibility and curiosity to connect cutting-edge science with business needs, innovation opportunities, and long-term value creation.

• Applying 10+ years of experience in R&D, scientific innovation, external collaborations, or related scientific leadership to shape strategy, influence stakeholders, and deliver measurable impact.

• Leveraging strong experience across Nestlé Research, Nestlé Product Technology Centers, and the broader R&D organization to foster connections between capabilities, partnerships, expertise, and scientific services, ensuring alignment with business and innovation priorities.

• Demonstrating success in academic partnerships, innovation ecosystems, with a proven ability to create trusted relationships and deliver measurable impact.

• Proven experience in leading complex initiatives in a direct or indirect leadership role.

• Bringing experience in the management, development, or strategic utilization of scientific infrastructures, research services, knowledge platforms, or shared capabilities.

• Demonstrating strong strategic communication and influencing skills, with the ability to translate complex scientific topics into compelling narratives, build alignment, and engage diverse internal and external stakeholders.

• Bringing collaboration, intellectual curiosity, fresh thinking, constructive challenge, respect, and a positive mindset.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Als Research Alliances & Science Insourcing Lead bei Nestlé Research möchten Sie sicherstellen, dass Nestlé Research Zugang zu den besten Wissenschaften weltweit hat. Durch die Leitung von Forschungsallianzen, Science Insourcing und Scientific Intelligence stärken Sie den Zugang zu externem Fachwissen, wissenschaftlichem Wissen, Literatur und Innovationsökosystemen, die die wissenschaftlichen Fähigkeiten von Nestlé Research ergänzen und erweitern. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Forschungsleitern, Wissenschafts- und Technologieteams, Rechts- und Vertragspartnern, Universitäten, Forschungsinstituten, Start-ups, wissenschaftlichen Verlagen, Verbänden und externen Experten helfen Sie dabei, Ideen in nachhaltige und innovative Lösungen für Menschen, Haustiere und den Planeten zu verwandeln.

Wie Sie als Research Alliances & Science Insourcing Lead Einfluss nehmen können

• Führen der Forschungsallianzen und der Science-Insourcing-Strategie zum Aufbau hochwertiger Partnerschaften mit Hochschulen, Startups, Verlagen, wissenschaftlichen und Innovationsökosystemen.

• Förderung strategischer Kooperationen, die die Entdeckung beschleunigen, die Innovationswirkung stärken und die Prioritäten von Nestlé Research unterstützen.

• Schaffung eines nahtlosen Zugangs zu internen und externen wissenschaftlichen Erkenntnissen durch die Verbindung von Forschern mit Experten, wissenschaftlicher Literatur, Verlagen, Informationsquellen und Forschungsdiensten, die Nestlé Research Fähigkeiten erweitern.

• Die Transformation wissenschaftlicher Intelligenz in eine strategische Fähigkeit durch die Identifizierung, Verknüpfung und Übersetzung von aufkommenden wissenschaftlichen Trends, Publikationen und externem Fachwissen in umsetzbare Erkenntnisse für Forschung und Innovation.

• Stärkung des wissenschaftlichen Rufs von Nestlé Research durch den Aufbau vertrauenswürdiger Beziehungen zu Universitäten, Talentpools und externen Vordenkern.

• Entwicklung eines engagierten, integrativen und zukunftsfähigen Teams, das Fähigkeiten aufbaut, die Zusammenarbeit fördert und gemeinsame Prioritäten setzt.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Bringen Sie einen PhD oder einen gleichwertigen wissenschaftlichen Hintergrund mit, kombiniert mit der Glaubwürdigkeit und Neugier, Spitzenwissenschaft mit Geschäftsanforderungen, Innovationsmöglichkeiten und langfristiger Wertschöpfung zu verbinden.

• Anwendung von mehr als 10 Jahren Erfahrung in Forschung und Entwicklung, wissenschaftlicher Innovation, externer Zusammenarbeit oder verwandter wissenschaftlicher Führung, um Strategien zu gestalten, Interessengruppen zu beeinflussen und messbare Auswirkungen zu erzielen.

• Nutzung starker Erfahrung in Nestlé Research, Nestlé Product Technology Centern und der breiteren F & E-Organisation, um Verbindungen zwischen Fähigkeiten, Partnerschaften, Fachwissen und wissenschaftlichen Dienstleistungen zu fördern und die Ausrichtung auf Geschäfts- und Innovationsprioritäten sicherzustellen.

• Nachweis des Erfolgs in akademischen Partnerschaften, Innovationsökosystemen, mit der nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, vertrauenswürdige Beziehungen aufzubauen und messbare Auswirkungen zu erzielen.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Initiativen in einer direkten oder indirekten Führungsrolle.

• Mitbringen von Erfahrung in der Verwaltung, Entwicklung oder strategischen Nutzung von wissenschaftlichen Infrastrukturen, Forschungsdienstleistungen, Wissensplattformen oder gemeinsamen Fähigkeiten.

• Demonstrieren starker strategischer Kommunikation und beeinflussender Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe wissenschaftliche Themen in überzeugende Narrative zu übersetzen, Ausrichtung aufzubauen und verschiedene interne und externe Interessengruppen einzubeziehen.

• Bringt Zusammenarbeit, intellektuelle Neugier, frisches Denken, konstruktive Herausforderung, Respekt und eine positive Denkweise.

Wir verpflichten uns zu einer inklusiven und respektvollen einstellungserfahrung und freuen uns, bei bedarf angemessene unterkünfte zu bieten. Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a Senior Acquisitions & Business Development Manager within our global M&A team, you will play a key role in shaping and executing strategic corporate projects that support the long-term growth of the Nestlé Group. Leading acquisitions, divestments, joint-ventures and other high-impact initiatives, you will ensure strong governance, rigorous valuation, and effective negotiations that create value and manage risk. Working closely with Zone and SBU leadership, Market Heads and CFOs, senior management, and specialist internal and external partners, you will help turn strategic opportunities into measurable business impact on a global scale, working across categories and geographies.

How you’ll make an impact as a Senior Acquisition & Business Development Manager

• Partner with Zones and Strategic Business Units to shape M&A strategies and evaluate potential acquisition or divestment opportunities.

• Lead end-to-end acquisition and divestment processes, ensuring projects follow the appropriate governance and approval requirements.

• Assess financial, strategic, and operational risks and opportunities to strengthen decision-making and negotiation positions.

• Lead negotiations on transaction agreements to optimize value and manage risk for Nestlé.

• Provide timely, clear, and decision-relevant information to senior management throughout the project lifecycle.

• Coordinate internal specialists and manage relationships with investment banks, financial advisers, accounting advisers, legal counsel, and other external partners to ensure the timely completion of projects.

What will make you successful

• Extensive experience in mergers and acquisitions or in leading complex projects within a multinational organization, consultancy, investment bank, or financial advisory environment.

• Strong expertise in financial management, business analysis, valuation, governance, risk management, and strategic business planning.

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across functions, businesses, and geographies.

• Fluency in English, with additional languages considered an advantage, combined with flexibility, sound judgement, and the ability to operate effectively in a complex global environment.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

At Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, interviews with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role on the date listed above, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

Was Sie von unserem Einstellungsprozess erwarten können

Wir verpflichten uns zu einer inklusiven und respektvollen einstellungserfahrung und freuen uns, bei bedarf angemessene unterkünfte zu bieten. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden von einer starken Sicherheitskultur mit modernen Installationen und Verfahren unterstützt, um eine sichere Umgebung für alle zu gewährleisten.

Der Einstellungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Interview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Interview mit dem Einstellungsteam und eine abschließende Diskussion und ein Angebot. Abhängig von der Rolle kann eine Videobewertung enthalten sein. Wir überprüfen Bewerbungen, sobald sie eingegangen sind, und schließen die Rolle, sobald eine starke Liste relevanter Kandidaten identifiziert wurde, daher empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich frühzeitig zu bewerben. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Bleiben Sie wachsam: Nestlé wird Kandidaten nur über offizielle Firmen-E-Mail-Adressen kontaktieren und wird zu keinem Zeitpunkt des Einstellungsprozesses Zahlungen oder sensible persönliche Informationen verlangen.

Bereit für #BreakthroughTogether?

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und gestalten Sie die Zukunft durch wissenschaftliche Durchbrüche und Innovationen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Lieu: Lausanne, Suisse
Modèle de travail: Sur place / À temps plein
Type / durée du contrat: Permanent

Façonner l'avenir grâce aux percées scientifiques et à l'innovation

En tant que technicien principal en chimie analytique à Nestlé Research, votre mission est d'élaborer et de gérer des méthodes analytiques qui appuient la conformité des aliments, l'évaluation des risques de contaminants chimiques et l'atténuation des risques. Vous ferez une différence en collaborant étroitement avec les membres de l'équipe et du projet, les services techniques, les groupes d'analyse, les partenaires commerciaux, les équipes de qualité, les fournisseurs de technologie et les fournisseurs externes. C'est l'occasion de transformer les idées en solutions durables et innovantes pour les gens, les animaux et la planète.

Comment vous ferez un impact en tant que technicien principal en chimie analytique

• Élaborer des méthodes d'analyse qui renforcent la salubrité des aliments, la conformité et l'évaluation des risques liés aux contaminants chimiques.

• Gérer l'équipement de laboratoire avancé pour fournir des données fiables et des résultats analytiques de haute qualité.

• Validation des méthodes de conduite, gestion du cycle de vie et amélioration continue conformément aux normes de qualité.

• Soutenir l'assistance technique aux marchés et aux partenaires avec des recommandations pratiques et un dépannage robuste.

• Contribuer aux rapports scientifiques, aux procédures de laboratoire, aux publications et à la communication claire des résultats analytiques.

• Encadrer les apprentis et les étudiants tout en partageant les connaissances techniques entre les équipes et les domaines de travail.

• Assurer de bonnes pratiques de laboratoire et promouvoir un état d'esprit de sécurité dans le laboratoire

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Apporter une formation en chimie analytique, comme un CFC, HES, un baccalauréat ou une qualification équivalente.

• Application pratique de l'expérience industrielle en chimie analytique pour fournir des méthodes, des résultats et un soutien technique fiables.

• Utilisation d'une solide expertise en chromatographie liquide et en chromatographie gazeuse associée à des techniques de spectrométrie de masse, y compris des instruments et des logiciels connexes.

• Appliquer l'évaluation des méthodes rapides (p. ex., essais de débit latéral) aux exigences de la méthode

• Collaborer de façon proactive entre les équipes, prendre des initiatives, rester bien organisé et contribuer à un environnement d'équipe positif.

• Communiquer efficacement en anglais et en français, surtout en lecture et en écriture.

• Apporter la collaboration, la pensée nouvelle, les questions audacieuses, le respect et un état d'esprit positif et axé sur le bien-être, pour créer une valeur partagée.

Chez Nestlé Research, nous plaçons les gens au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons

Nos avantages sont conçus pour soutenir votre croissance et votre bien-être, afin que vous puissiez prospérer au travail et dans la vie:

• Options de travail flexibles, y compris les possibilités de travail hybride (pour les rôles de bureau)

• Jours fériés payés au-delà des exigences légales

• Possibilités d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement pour développer votre carrière

• Prime basée sur les performances

• Contribution en soins de santé et accès au Programme d'aide aux employés

• Une forte cotisation de l'employeur à votre régime de retraite

• Congé parental généreux et solutions globales de soutien familial

• Réductions attrayantes pour les employés pour divers produits et services

À quoi s'attendre de notre processus d'embauche

Nous sommes déterminés à offrir une expérience d'embauche inclusive et respectueuse et sommes heureux de fournir des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables au besoin. Nos lieux de travail sont entièrement accessibles et soutenus par une solide culture de sécurité, avec des installations et des procédures modernes pour assurer un environnement sûr pour tous.

Le processus d'embauche comprend habituellement une entrevue avec Talent Acquisition, une entrevue avec l'équipe d'embauche et une discussion et une offre finales. Selon le rôle, une évaluation vidéo peut être incluse. Nous examinons les candidatures reçues et clôturons le rôle une fois qu'une liste solide de candidats pertinents a été établie. Nous vous encourageons donc à présenter votre candidature tôt. Toutes les informations sont traitées de manière confidentielle.

Restez vigilant : Nestlé communiquera uniquement avec les candidats par l'intermédiaire des adresses courriel officielles de l'entreprise et ne demandera jamais de paiements ou de renseignements personnels sensibles à aucune étape du processus d'embauche.

Prêt à #BreakthroughTogether ?

Appliquer maintenant et façonner l'avenir par des percées scientifiques et l'innovation.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ubicazione: Orbe, Svizzera

Entità: Nestlé Svizzera S.A.

Durata: stage di 6 mesi dal febbraio 2027 (data di entrata flessibile)

Vuoi condurre un progetto concreto nel cuore del nostro sistema di qualità?

Nell'ambito dell'implementazione di SenseIT, la soluzione digitale di Nestlé dedicata alla gestione delle valutazioni sensoriali, stiamo cercando uno stagista in grado di pilotare questo progetto con grande autonomia. Questa soluzione consente di digitalizzare le valutazioni sensoriali, facilitare l'integrazione con SAP, accedere in tempo reale alle informazioni e migliorare la conformità dei processi.

La tua missione

All'interno del team Quality del Fabrique Nescafé di Orbe, contribuirai alla digitalizzazione e al miglioramento continuo del nostro sistema di gestione della qualità. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con i team di qualità e operativi e le varie parti interessate sul sito.

Questo corso è inteso per una persona proattiva, strutturata e responsabile, in grado di organizzare il suo lavoro, sollecitare gli interlocutori giusti e spostare i suoi soggetti avanti con supervisione limitata. Il tirocinio è aperto solo agli studenti che sono nel corso di studio o hanno ottenuto il diploma meno di un anno fa.

Come creare impatto

• Sostenere il progetto SenseIT con un alto livello di autonomia, dalla comprensione della necessità di implementare la soluzione.

• Analizzare le pratiche attuali, identificare le opportunità di miglioramento e proporre soluzioni semplici, efficienti e personalizzate alle esigenze operative.

• Raccogliere, strutturare e utilizzare le informazioni del progetto in base alla documentazione, agli standard e agli stakeholder.

• Coordinare gli scambi con diversi attori, monitorare le azioni e contribuire all'allineamento delle squadre.

• Soluzioni di prova, risultati dei documenti e sviluppo di standard, procedure e supporti per garantire un uso sostenibile dello strumento.

• Sostenere gli utenti nell'adottare la soluzione e monitorare i progressi del progetto con gli indicatori di performance.

• Per contribuire più ampiamente alla digitalizzazione e al miglioramento continuo dei processi di qualità.

Che cosa farà il vostro successo

• Si sta subendo una formazione avanzata in ingegneria, miglioramento continuo, sistemi industriali o in un campo simile o laureato meno di un anno fa.

• Si mostra grande autonomia, curiosità e iniziativa, e sapere come progredire in un progetto anche quando non tutte le risposte sono immediatamente disponibili.

• Siete in grado di trasformare un obiettivo in un piano d'azione concreto, definire le vostre priorità e svolgere diverse attività in parallelo.

• Hai una forte mentalità analitica e sai come cercare efficacemente, strutturare e sintetizzare le informazioni.

• Siete rigorosi, organizzati e attenti ai dettagli.

• È possibile comunicare con una varietà di persone e creare una dinamica di collaborazione.

• Sei a tuo agio con strumenti digitali e Microsoft Office (incluso Copilot); Esperienza nella gestione dei dati, digitalizzazione o visualizzazione è un bene.

• Si comunica fluentemente in francese; l'inglese è un bene.

• La conoscenza dei sistemi di gestione della qualità, il miglioramento continuo o un ambiente industriale è un vantaggio.

Pronto a rispondere alla sfida? Se siete alla ricerca di uno stage durante il quale si può davvero prendere la responsabilità, gestire il proprio progetto e dare un contributo concreto alla trasformazione del sistema di qualità della nostra fabbrica, questa opportunità è fatta per voi.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Location : Orbe, Switzerland

Entity: Nestlé Switzerland S.A.

Duration: 6 month internship from February 2027 (flexible entry date)

Want to lead a concrete project at the heart of our quality system?

As part of the deployment of SenseIT, Nestlé's digital solution dedicated to the management of sensory assessments, we are looking for an intern able to pilot this project with great autonomy. This solution makes it possible to digitize sensory assessments, facilitate integration with SAP, access real-time information and enhance process compliance.

Your Mission

Within the Quality team of the Fabrique Nescafé in Orbe, you will contribute to the digitisation and continuous improvement of our quality management system. You will work closely with the Quality and Operational Teams and the various stakeholders on the site.

This course is intended for a proactive, structured and responsible person, able to organize his/her work, solicit the right interlocutors and move his/her subjects forward with limited supervision. The traineeship is open only to students who are in the course of study or have obtained their diploma less than a year ago.

How you will create impact

• Support the SenseIT project with a high level of autonomy, from understanding the need to deploying the solution.

• Analyze current practices, identify opportunities for improvement and propose simple, efficient and tailored solutions to operational needs.

• Collect, structure and use project information based on documentation, standards and stakeholders.

• Coordinate exchanges with different actors, monitor actions and contribute to the alignment of teams.

• Test solutions, document results, and develop standards, procedures and supports to ensure sustainable use of the tool.

• Support users in adopting the solution and monitor project progress with performance indicators.

• To contribute more widely to digitalisation and continuous improvement of quality processes.

What Will Make Your Success

• You are undergoing advanced training in engineering, continuous improvement, industrial systems or in a similar field or graduated less than a year ago.

• You show great autonomy, curiosity and initiative, and know how to progress in a project even when not all the answers are immediately available.

• You are able to transform a goal into a concrete action plan, define your priorities and carry out several activities in parallel.

• You have a strong analytical mindset and know how to effectively search, structure and synthesize information.

• You are rigorous, organized and attentive to details.

• You can communicate with a variety of people and create a dynamic of collaboration.

• You are comfortable with digital tools and Microsoft Office (including Copilot); Experience in data management, digitization or visualization is an asset.

• You communicate fluently in French; English is an asset.

• Knowledge of quality management systems, continuous improvement or an industrial environment is an advantage.

Ready to meet the challenge? If you are looking for an internship during which you can really take responsibility, manage your own project and make a concrete contribution to the transformation of the quality system of our factory, this opportunity is made for you.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Standort: Orbe, Schweiz

Stelle: Nestlé Switzerland S.A.

Dauer: 6 Monate Praktikum ab Februar 2027 (flexibles Einstiegsdatum)

Möchten Sie ein konkretes Projekt im Herzen unseres Qualitätssystems leiten?

Im Rahmen des Einsatzes von SenseIT, Nestlés digitaler Lösung für das Management sensorischer Bewertungen, suchen wir einen Praktikanten, der in der Lage ist, dieses Projekt mit großer Autonomie zu pilotieren. Diese Lösung ermöglicht es, sensorische Bewertungen zu digitalisieren, die Integration mit SAP zu erleichtern, auf Echtzeitinformationen zuzugreifen und die Prozesskonformität zu verbessern.

Deine Mission

Im Qualitätsteam der Fabrique Nescafé in Orbe tragen Sie zur Digitalisierung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unseres Qualitätsmanagementsystems bei. Sie werden eng mit den Qualitäts- und Betriebsteams und den verschiedenen Stakeholdern auf der Website zusammenarbeiten.

Dieser Kurs richtet sich an eine proaktive, strukturierte und verantwortliche Person, die in der Lage ist, ihre Arbeit zu organisieren, die richtigen Gesprächspartner zu erbitten und ihre Themen mit begrenzter Aufsicht voranzubringen. Das Praktikum steht nur Studierenden offen, die sich im Studium befinden oder ihr Diplom vor weniger als einem Jahr erworben haben.

Wie Sie Wirkung erzielen

• Unterstützen Sie das SenseIT-Projekt mit einem hohen Maß an Autonomie, vom Verständnis der Notwendigkeit bis zur Bereitstellung der Lösung.

• Analysieren Sie aktuelle Praktiken, identifizieren Sie Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten und schlagen Sie einfache, effiziente und maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für betriebliche Anforderungen vor.

• Sammeln, Strukturieren und Verwenden von Projektinformationen basierend auf Dokumentation, Standards und Stakeholdern.

• Koordinieren Sie den Austausch mit verschiedenen Akteuren, überwachen Sie die Aktionen und tragen Sie zur Ausrichtung der Teams bei.

• Testen Sie Lösungen, dokumentieren Sie Ergebnisse und entwickeln Sie Standards, Verfahren und Unterstützung, um eine nachhaltige Nutzung des Tools zu gewährleisten.

• Unterstützen Sie die Benutzer bei der Annahme der Lösung und überwachen Sie den Projektfortschritt mit Leistungsindikatoren.

• Einen breiteren Beitrag zur Digitalisierung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Qualitätsprozessen zu leisten.

Was wird Ihren Erfolg machen

• Sie durchlaufen eine Weiterbildung in Ingenieurwissenschaften, kontinuierlicher Verbesserung, industriellen Systemen oder in einem ähnlichen Bereich oder haben vor weniger als einem Jahr einen Abschluss gemacht.

• Sie zeigen große Autonomie, Neugier und Initiative und wissen, wie Sie in einem Projekt vorankommen, auch wenn nicht alle Antworten sofort verfügbar sind.

• Sie können ein Ziel in einen konkreten Aktionsplan umwandeln, Ihre Prioritäten definieren und mehrere Aktivitäten parallel durchführen.

• Sie haben eine starke analytische Denkweise und wissen, wie Sie Informationen effektiv suchen, strukturieren und synthetisieren können.

• Sie sind streng, organisiert und aufmerksam auf Details.

• Sie können mit einer Vielzahl von Menschen kommunizieren und eine Dynamik der Zusammenarbeit schaffen.

• Sie sind mit digitalen Tools und Microsoft Office (einschließlich Copilot) vertraut; Erfahrung in Datenmanagement, Digitalisierung oder Visualisierung ist eine Bereicherung.

• Sie kommunizieren fließend auf Französisch; Englisch ist ein Gewinn.

• Kenntnisse über Qualitätsmanagementsysteme, kontinuierliche Verbesserung oder ein industrielles Umfeld sind von Vorteil.

Bereit für die Herausforderung? Wenn Sie ein Praktikum suchen, bei dem Sie wirklich Verantwortung übernehmen, Ihr eigenes Projekt leiten und einen konkreten Beitrag zur Transformation des Qualitätssystems unserer Fabrik leisten können, ist diese Gelegenheit für Sie gegeben.

Lieu : Orbe, Suisse

• Vous faites preuve d’une grande autonomie, de curiosité et d’esprit d’initiative, et savez progresser dans un projet même lorsque toutes les réponses ne sont pas immédiatement disponibles.

• Vous êtes rigoureux·se, organisé·e et attentif·ve aux détails.

• Vous savez communiquer avec des interlocuteurs variés et créer une dynamique de collaboration.

• Vous communiquez couramment en français ; l’anglais constitue un atout.

• Une connaissance des systèmes de management de la qualité, de l’amélioration continue ou d’un environnement industriel est un avantage.

Prêt·e à relever le défi ? Si vous recherchez un stage durant lequel vous pourrez réellement prendre des responsabilités, gérer votre propre projet et contribuer concrètement à la transformation du système qualité de notre fabrique, cette opportunité est faite pour vous.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Location: Vevey, Switzerland

Entity : Nestlé SA
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Target start date: ASAP

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

As a Communications Manager – Content & Editorial at Nestlé, your mission is to help shape and elevate corporate storytelling by driving editorial excellence and content strategy across internal and external channels. You’ll make a difference by bringing a proactive approach and collaborating closely with Corporate Affairs teams, Content Studios, markets, functions, and subject-matter experts. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Communications Manager – Content & Editorial

• Driving a forward-looking content strategy and editorial planning that brings business priorities, purpose, and reputation topics to life.

• Building compelling storylines and narratives across articles, scripts, long-form storytelling, and social content to strengthen trust and engagement.

• Delivering end-to-end content development, actively drafting and refining content, while also briefing, guiding, and reviewing work with internal teams, studios, and agencies.

• Overseeing the planning and creation of content assets, including articles, scripts, videos, social assets and long-form storytelling.

• Empowering a high-performing Content & Editorial team through clear priorities, coaching, and consistent feedback.

• Improving content impact by using performance insights and feedback to continuously evolve formats, language, and storytelling approaches.

What will make you successful

• Bringing proven experience in corporate communications, journalism, or editorial/content leadership to deliver inspiring, high-quality content and campaigns that strengthen trust and reputation.

• Applying excellent writing and editing skills to translate complex topics into crisp language, while safeguarding tone of voice and reputational risk.

• Shaping content strategy and storytelling, using audience needs and performance insights to improve impact.

• Ideating and delivering end-to-end multimedia content.

• As a people-focused team leader, developing and coaching others while partnering confidently in a fast-paced matrix environment.

• Communicating with full professional proficiency in English (expert proficiency in written English).

• Championing continuous improvement, innovation and new storytelling, including effective use of emerging tools and technologies.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

At Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do.

We offer a competitive and well-rounded benefits package designed to support your growth and wellbeing at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office-based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and final interviews and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Ready to Be a Force for Good?

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

Formare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione.

In qualità di Responsabile del Prodotto Scientifico presso Nestlé Research nel nostro dipartimento di Scienze Computazionali, la vostra missione sarà quella di possedere il ciclo di vita dei prodotti di dati scientifici in agricoltura, imballaggio, ricerca clinica, sicurezza alimentare e settori scientifici per la salute e la nutrizione - rinforzando e aumentando il valore delle basi dati di Nestlé Research. Identificherete le opportunità di alto valore, tradurre le esigenze scientifiche in prodotti di dati impattanti, e portare la consegna interfunzionale dalla scoperta attraverso l'adozione e comunicare lo stesso attraverso un coinvolgente roadmap del prodotto.

Come farete un impatto come responsabile del prodotto dei dati scientifici

• Condurre flussi di lavoro interfunzionali in un ambiente di ricerca dinamico, definendo la visione del prodotto, i requisiti, le priorità e i criteri di successo che allineano la scienza, i dati e la tecnologia.

• Partner con gli stakeholder scientifici per identificare esigenze di alto valore, migliorare la qualità dei dati, rafforzare i metadati e rendere i dati di ricerca più rilevabili e riutilizzabili attraverso i principi FAIR.

• Traduci le esigenze scientifiche in prodotti di dati scalabili attraverso bioinformatica, condotte cliniche e omiche, dalla scoperta attraverso l'adozione.

• Esperti interni orchestrati — tra cui scienziati, proprietari di domini dati, architetti, scienziati di dati, ingegneri e sviluppatori di software — insieme a partner esterni per accelerare la consegna prioritaria.

• Campione AI-enabled prodotti di dati, utilizzando l'automazione e AI per trasformare i dati scientifici affidabili e ben governati in insight più veloci e intelligenti.

• I propri prodotti di dati scientifici a lungo termine, bilanciando la fattibilità e l'impatto utilizzando l'adozione, la soddisfazione e il valore fornito per guidare il miglioramento continuo.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Bachelor o Master o PhD in Bioinformatica, scienze della vita, chimica o informatica, ingegneria o equivalente, combinando la comprensione del dominio scientifico con l'esperienza dei dati.

• Esperienza professionale significativa che guida la semina, l'implementazione, l'adozione e la gestione del ciclo di vita dei prodotti di dati in un contesto scientifico, preferibilmente in cibo, scienze della vita o farmaci.

• Competenza necessaria:

•

• Esperienza solida con domini di dati di ricerca Bioinformatics o Clinical o Omics

• Capacità comprovata di identificare le esigenze aziendali e scientifiche, eseguire l'analisi delle parti interessate, tradurre i requisiti in backlog di prodotto, e prioritizzare la consegna in base a valore, fattibilità e allineamento strategico.

• Forte capacità di proprietà del prodotto, tra cui gestione roadmap, priorità backlog, design user-centric, definizione del valore, strategie di test, monitoraggio dell'adozione e miglioramento continuo.

• Solida comprensione dei concetti di ingegneria dei dati, tra cui modelli di dati, pipeline, ETL/ELT, API, metadati, qualità dei dati, governance dei dati e architetture di analisi, con la capacità di guidare decisioni tecniche e proposte di sfida.

• Comprensione degli ecosistemi di dati moderni - piattaforme cloud, data warehouse, (ad esempio, Snowflake), tecnologie Linux e container, strumenti di orchestrazione (ad esempio, Airflow), pratiche DevOps.

• Competenza piacevole da avere

• Modellazione semantica, onlogie e grafi di conoscenza (ad esempio, RDF/SPARQL, vocabulari biomedici/chimici).

• implementazione dei dati FAIR, gestione dei metadati e strumenti di linea

• L'esperienza con strumenti di reporting (ad esempio, DASH, Streamlit, Power BI) è un vantaggio

• Esperienza di leadership

• Esperienza coordinando la consegna attraverso team interni multidisciplinari e partner esterni.

• Capacità di navigare nella complessità, gestire l'ambiguità e allineare gli stakeholder scientifici, aziendali e tecnici intorno a priorità chiare.

Formare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione.

In qualità di Senior Technician in Micronutrients e Phytochemicals Analytics presso Nestlé Research, la vostra missione è quella di fornire un supporto analitico di alta qualità che aiuta i team di ricerca e di operazioni a prendere decisioni sicure e basate sulla scienza. Potrai fare la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con scienziati, esperti analitici, team tecnici e partner in Nestlé Research. Questa è la vostra occasione per trasformare le idee in soluzioni sostenibili e innovative per persone, animali domestici e il pianeta.

Come farete un impatto come Senior Technician in Micronutrienti e Phytochemicals Analytics

• Fornire dati analitici affidabili che supportano la ricerca, la qualità del prodotto e le decisioni operative.

• Sviluppare e applicare metodi di preparazione dei campioni all'interno dei progetti, compresi gli approcci per allergeni, microparticelle, micronutrienti e analisi dei fitochimici e le misurazioni spettroscopiche.

• Funzionamento e mantenimento di attrezzature analitiche avanzate per garantire risultati robusti, tempestivi e di alta qualità.

• Valutare i risultati analitici in modo critico e trasformare i risultati in chiare intuizioni per i team di progetto e gli stakeholder.

• Contribuire allo sviluppo dei metodi e fornire assistenza tecnica ai mercati, compreso il supporto analitico per gli argomenti legati all'allergene in cui il ruolo può richiedere la manipolazione o essere in contatto diretto con materiali alimentari allergeni.

• Sostenere i team di progetto con assistenza tecnica, preparazione del campione per l'analisi delle tracce e l'interpretazione analitica per garantire una fornitura robusta degli obiettivi del progetto.

• Condivisione delle competenze con colleghi, apprendisti e studenti per costruire capacità nelle attività analitiche.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare una laurea, CFC o qualifica equivalente in chimica analitica o un campo correlato, con solida esperienza nella preparazione del campione acquisita nell'industria o nell'accademia.

Deadline for applications: 13 October 2026

Be a force for good and transform your potential into something extraordinary

As an SPX Data Analytics Intern at Nespresso , your mission will be to transform sensory and product experience data into actionable learning for coffee innovation.

You will support the collection, preparation, analysis, modelling, visualisation and documentation of large datasets while contributing to a predictive modelling project using machine learning. Working closely with the SPX Insight Specialist, SPX Data Specialist and partners across R&D, Marketing, Consumer & Market Intelligence, E-commerce and IT, you will gain hands-on experience at the intersection of data science, consumer insights and coffee innovation.

How you’ll make an impact as an SPX Data Analytics Intern

• Prepare, analyse, model sensory and product experience (SPX) data in order to develop a predictive model using machine learning to generate clear and useful insights

• Support KPI reporting and create effective dashboards and visualisations using tools such as Power BI or KNIME

• Perform data-quality checks and help improve the efficiency, reproducibility and traceability of data-management activities

• Contribute to the testing and continuous improvement of data tools while documenting your methods, findings and recommendations

• Collaborate with technical and non-technical partners and present your findings clearly to the SPX team and broader R&D stakeholders

What will make you successful

• Currently completing a Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Engineering, Consumer Science, Sensory Science or a related field

• Data science and coding skills, with practical knowledge of Python or R. Experience (work or academic) with Snowflake, Power BI, KNIME or similar tools and platforms is an advantage

• Hands-on experience preparing, analysing, modelling and visualising datasets through academic or practical projects

• Ability to interpret data and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

• Curious, analytical and detail-oriented, with a proactive and solution-focused approach

• Fluent in English. French or another language is an advantage

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value

At Nespresso, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office-based roles)

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to start your career journey with us?

Apply now and transform your potential into something extraordinary.

Essere una forza per il bene e sentirsi fidati di prendere decisioni che importa.

In qualità di Global Procurement Manager for Contract Manufacturing presso Nestlé Global Procurement, la vostra missione è quella di guidare le attività commerciali e sourcing per la categoria Global Contract Manufacturing. Segnalando al Global Categoria Lead, definirai e implementerai strategie di categoria, guiderai iniziative strategiche di approvvigionamento e collaborerai con stakeholder interfunzionali per fornire valore, ottimizzare le prestazioni dei fornitori e sostenere la crescita aziendale.

Operiamo su scala mondiale, mettendo insieme oltre 40 nazionalità in tre hub dinamici in Svizzera, Panama e Malesia. Questa è la tua occasione per guidare l'innovazione, la sostenibilità e l'impatto su scala, assicurando la creazione di valore attraverso la fornitura responsabile attraverso diverse categorie.

Come farai un impatto come Global Procurement Manager - Contract Manufacturing

• Rappresentare il Procurement in progetti aziendali interfunzionali, tra cui nuovi lancio di prodotti, espansioni geografiche, iniziative di miglioramento dei costi, transizioni dei fornitori e pianificazione della continuità aziendale.

• Leader relazioni strategiche con i produttori di contratti, guidando iniziative di performance sostenibili, innovazione e miglioramento continuo.

• Gestisci le attività di sourcing end-to-end per i nuovi lanci di prodotto, dalla scouting dei fornitori e dalla selezione ai negoziati commerciali e l'esecuzione dei contratti.

• Sviluppare un'intelligenza e un'esperienza di mercato profonde sul panorama globale della produzione di contratti rilevanti per il portafoglio business.

• Fornire obiettivi di riduzione dei costi, garantendo elevati livelli di prestazioni, qualità e continuità di servizio.

• Collabora con gli stakeholder aziendali per allineare le strategie di approvvigionamento con gli obiettivi di crescita, le esigenze operative e la sicurezza di approvvigionamento.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Esperienza ben consolidata negli appalti, offrendo un vantaggio competitivo attraverso un approvvigionamento strategico all'interno di ambienti multi-paese.

• Esperienza solida nello sviluppo e nell'esecuzione di strategie di approvvigionamento, sfruttando le competenze nella gestione dei rischi dei fornitori, nell'assistenza responsabile e nei negoziati commerciali.

• Provato record di traccia nella gestione delle relazioni dei fornitori e dei programmi di sviluppo.

• Capacità di influenzare gli stakeholder senior e i team interfunzionali rappresentando l'approvvigionamento in modo efficace e promuovendo la collaborazione in un'organizzazione globale complessa.

• Fluency in inglese, un'altra lingua sarà un bene.

Al Nestlé Global Procurement, mettiamo le persone nel cuore di tutto ciò che facciamo.

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili, comprese le possibilità di lavoro ibride (per ruoli basati su ufficio)

• Vacanze pagate oltre i requisiti legali

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Bonus basato sulle prestazioni

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Forte contributo del datore di lavoro al vostro piano pensionistico

• Generoso congedo parentale e soluzioni complete di supporto familiare

• Sconti interessanti per i dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati a un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo lieti di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione comprende tipicamente un'intervista video con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che viene identificata una forte lista di candidati rilevanti, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Senior Specialist Metabolic Health – Hormone Regulation at Nestlé Research, your mission is to advance nutrition-based health solutions by deepening scientific understanding of how hormonal regulation influences metabolic health, body composition and physiological functions. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with scientists, innovation partners and technical teams across Nestlé Research and the wider research and development community. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Senior Specialist Metabolic Health – Hormone Regulation

• Leading research that links nutrition, hormonal regulation and metabolic health to create new health-focused innovation opportunities.

• Translating scientific evidence on gut hormones, insulin sensitivity, sex hormones and body composition into actionable nutrition concepts.

• Developing mechanistic insights that help move scientific observations into clear modes of action and stronger health recommendations.

• Building external scientific networks in metabolic health, endocrinology and women’s health to strengthen collaboration and future innovation.

• Contributing high-quality scientific outputs, including research milestones, publications, presentations and innovation inputs.

• Inspiring cross-functional teams and supporting junior team members through coaching and mentoring, while connecting deep scientific expertise with practical nutrition solutions that improve health outcomes.

What will make you successful

• Bringing a PhD or MD/PhD with recognized scientific expertise in metabolic health and hormone regulation, including gut-derived hormones, insulin sensitivity and sex hormones, with extensive years of relevant experience.

• Applying experience in nutritional interventions, health outcomes and human physiology to generate robust scientific insights.

• Using project leadership, stakeholder engagement and scientific communication skills to turn evidence into meaningful innovation.

• Collaborating with curiosity, agility and creativity across research, technology and innovation teams.

• Anwendung von Wissen über Lebensmittelsicherheit und Qualitätsprozesse im Kontext von Lieferketten, Vorfällen, Problementwicklung und potenziellen Auswirkungen auf die Verbraucher.

En tant que spécialiste de la sécurité alimentaire numérique à Nestlé Research, votre mission est de permettre la détection proactive des problèmes potentiels de sécurité alimentaire en renforçant l'évaluation des signaux scientifiques externes et l'évolution des systèmes numériques d'alerte précoce. Vous ferez une différence en collaborant étroitement avec les partenaires de la sécurité alimentaire, de la qualité, de la recherche, de la technologie et des données externes. C'est l'occasion de transformer les idées en solutions durables et innovantes pour les gens, les animaux domestiques et la planète.

Comment vous allez faire un impact en tant que spécialiste de la sécurité alimentaire numérique

• Renforcer l'alerte rapide proactive en matière de salubrité des aliments en faisant le point et en évaluant les nouveaux enjeux dans les secteurs de contaminants prioritaires.

• Déterminer et évaluer les sources de données internes et externes qui améliorent la détection, l'établissement de priorités et l'évaluation scientifique des signaux précoces.

• Diriger l'évaluation et le déploiement de technologies numériques qui améliorent la détection axée sur les données de nouveaux sujets liés à la salubrité des aliments.

• Coordonner les essais et la validation de prototypes qui aident à transformer les processus d'alerte rapide en solutions numériques évolutives.

• Établir des collaborations scientifiques solides qui relient la recherche, la technologie et les besoins des entreprises pour protéger les consommateurs.

• Mettre en oeuvre des activités de projet ciblées, rigoureuses et suivies pour appuyer les décisions relatives à la salubrité des aliments.

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Apporter des connaissances de base en chimie et une bonne compréhension des contaminants chimiques, y compris la façon dont ils peuvent émerger, évoluer et influer sur la salubrité des aliments.

• Appliquer la connaissance des processus de salubrité et de qualité des aliments dans le contexte des chaînes d'approvisionnement, des incidents, de l'évolution des enjeux et de l'impact potentiel des consommateurs.

• Utiliser les données et les technologies numériques dans un contexte de sécurité alimentaire, idéalement pour appuyer l'évaluation des risques fondée sur les données, l'analyse des causes profondes et la prise de décisions en matière d'alerte rapide.

• Collaborer efficacement avec divers partenaires internes et externes, tout en transformant la recherche en impact pratique.

• Communiquer couramment en anglais; apprendre le français est un atout.

• Apporter la collaboration, la pensée nouvelle, les questions audacieuses, le respect et un état d'esprit positif et axé sur le bien-être.

À Nestlé Research, nous plaçons les gens au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons.

Nos avantages sont conçus pour soutenir votre croissance et votre bien-être, afin que vous puissiez prospérer au travail et dans la vie:

• Une forte contribution de l'employeur à votre régime de retraite

• Congé parental généreux et solutions globales de soutien familial

Nous sommes déterminés à offrir une expérience d'embauche inclusive et respectueuse et sommes heureux de fournir des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables au besoin. descriptionByLocale.it:
Location: Vers-Chez-les-Blanc, Switzerland
Work model: On-site / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Specialist Macronutrient Physiology at Nestlé Research, you will be part of the Metabolic Health team within the Nestlé Institute of Health Sciences (NIHS) and your mission will be to provide scientific expertise in nutrition physiology to help develop nutrition-based health solutions and translate mechanistic insight into actionable dietary recommendations and intervention concepts. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with cross-functional scientists and technical teams across Nestlé Research, Nutrition & Health and other R&D centers. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Specialist Macronutrient Physiology

• Developing and executing cross-business research that advances understanding of macro- and micronutrient metabolism and nutrient quality.

• Analyzing and interpreting clinical & pre-clinical data on linking diet and metabolism to generate high-quality hypotheses and mechanistic insight.

• Strengthening the scientific evidence of on macro- micronutrient quality by moving from observed clinical correlations to causal modes of action & physiological mechanisms across populations and life stages.

• Designing and contributing to innovative nutrient-based intervention concepts, techniques, and research approaches that support breakthrough innovation.

• Translating scientific outputs into actionable recommendations, innovation inputs, and robust intellectual property support aligned to R&D priorities.

• Communicating and networking internally and externally through publications, presentations, and partnerships that build credibility and accelerate impact.

What will make you successful

• Bringing a PhD and 4–6 years of scientific experience in macro- and micronutrient quality and metabolism, linked to dietary recommendations and/or human physiology.

• Using clinical trial and nutrition-intervention insight to strengthen mechanistic evidence and translate findings into clear recommendations for new product and/or communication development.

• Leveraging systems biology thinking and data interpretation skills to connect dietary context, metabolism, and downstream health outcomes.

• Collaborating confidently across an academic-industry environment to align stakeholders, guide contributions, and deliver on shared milestones.

• Communicating fluently in English.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Ready to #BreakthroughTogether?

Apply now and shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.
